subject: Private Offer: Novaretail - concession request & payment terms
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@novaretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, contracts@novaretail.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer request - custom billing window & concession

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and multi-region routing. Procurement asked me to send a formal private-offer request with a couple of non-standard asks so we can move to legal. Details below: 

- Term: 12 months, start on signature date
- Commercial concession: 20% list discount for year 1 on hosted inference usage (applies to token spend only)
- Billing: Net 90 (company policy)
- Implementation: $75k one-time onboarding credit to be applied against first invoices
- Partner comms: deal will go through our systems and partner commission needs to be 12% of paid ARR (partner is CloudWave)

I attached a one-page request and draft SOW for context. Please let me know if this is something you can accommodate and what approvals are required. We are hoping to get signed before end of month.

Regards,
Alice Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaRetail Inc.
attachments: Novaretail-PrivOffer-Request.pdf; Novaretail-SOW-draft.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@novaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request - custom billing window & concession

Hi Alice — appreciate the note and the SOW.

Short answer: we can move quickly, but a couple of the asks (20% list discount + Net 90 + $75k onboarding credit + elevated partner commission) need internal sign-off. Ive flagged this with our deal desk / ops and finance. Can you confirm: is the $75k an implementation credit off invoiced amounts (i.e., offset to first invoices) or a separate prepaid credit? That affects recognition and billing.

I'll follow up once I have guidance from finance and my manager. If it helps, we can propose a revised set of concessions that balance your needs with our revenue recognition constraints.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private offer request - Novaretail (DEAL-7834) — exec approval needed

Team — forwarding Novaretail request (attached). Key asks: 20% first-year usage discount, Net 90 billing, $75k onboarding credit, and a 12% partner commission for CloudWave. They want signed by month-end.

Why escalate: 20% + $75k credit materially affects first-year margin; Net 90 shifts cash timing for a company this size; partner commission at 12% is slightly above standard for this channel.

What I need: 1) Marissa — approval for exception to list discount cap (we normally cap to 15% on enterprise self-serve); 2) Stephanie — confirm whether Net 90 is acceptable from a billing/credit risk perspective and whether we can structure the $75k as an onboarding credit vs prepaid; 3) Karthik — confirm partner split policy for CloudWave on deals with credits.

Attached: Novaretail-PrivOffer-Request.pdf; Novaretail-SOW-draft.docx

Thanks,
Jonas

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request - Novaretail (DEAL-7834) — exec approval needed

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. My decision approach: were willing to approve a calibrated concession that preserves runway economics while keeping the customer happy. Proposed approval (conditional):

- Discount: approve up to 15% off list for year 1 (not 20%).
- Onboarding credit: approve $50k (rather than $75k) to be applied as a one-time invoice credit on the first two invoices.
- Billing: Net 60 instead of Net 90; Net 90 raises too much credit risk for a first-year customer. Finance should confirm credit checks.
- Partner commission: approve 12% only if CloudWave signs an MSSA showing co-sell responsibilities and the commission is paid from net collected revenue (i.e., after credits). If credits reduce realized revenue, commission is computed on collected amount.

Stephanie — please confirm Net 60 / credit control gating and whether we need a revenue holdback clause. If credit check fails, we should require payment terms at Net 30 or a partial prepay.

If we can align, Jonas — send the revised offer; include the conditional language about partner commission being computed on collected revenue and the Net 60 payment gate pending credit approval. We can escalate to execs if legal or tax flags show up.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request - Novaretail (DEAL-7834) — finance input

All — quick finance take:
- Net 60 is acceptable with standard credit checks for a new customer. Please run the Experian / D&B report; if D&B rating < B, require Net 30 or a 25% prepayment.
- Onboarding credit: we can approve $50k invoice credit applied across first two invoices; we need a short addendum to the private offer documenting how the credit reduces taxable revenue.
- Partner commission: we will require commission to be paid on net collected revenue after credits. Also suggest adding a 90-day clawback window if an invoice is refunded or credits are applied post-payment.

If this is acceptable, legal can prepare the private-offer doc with conditional language and the finance-approved credit mechanics.

-Stephanie
Director, Finance (Revenue Ops)

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@novaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request - Novaretail (DEAL-7834) — Redwood revised offer

Hi Alice — thank you for the details and the SOW. Per internal approvals (sales ops + finance), here is the revised private-offer summary we can sign: 

- Term: 12 months from signature.
- Discount: 15% off list for year 1 (applies to hosted inference token spend only).
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 applied as invoice credits across the first two invoices.
- Billing: Net 60, subject to standard credit checks (Experian / D&B). If credit score is below threshold, Redwood reserves the right to require Net 30 or partial prepayment.
- Partner commission: CloudWave to receive 12% commission paid on net collected revenue after credits; 90-day clawback applies if invoices are refunded.

Attached is a draft private-offer summary and a redline-ready clause for partner commission computation. If this aligns, please confirm and I will route the private-offer to Legal/Contracts and send the DocuSign link. We can maintain the target of signing by 30 June if we get confirmation today.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas — thanks for moving quickly. NovaRetail accepts the revised terms (15% discount, $50k onboarding credit, Net 60 subject to credit check, partner commission on net collected revenue). We will send the signed SOW to your contracts team once we receive the DocuSign link.

Alice Wu
